purpose: Teach: やみ/がかっ/もしや/ヒロシ/ひろし/ひろ/いじり/ココ

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、容疑者は地下のやみ組織に関わっているようです
lines.en: The suspect appears to be involved with an underground criminal organization.
lines.style: Professional, matter-of-fact briefing tone. Measured pace. No inflection—just the facts. Posture upright, eyes steady. The voice of someone who has delivered difficult information many times.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、暗闇の中、青がかった光が記録されたんですね
lines.en: So there was blue-tinted light recorded in the darkness at the scene?
lines.style: Thoughtful, probing question. Slight hesitation before the question mark—thinking aloud. Leaning forward slightly. Genuinely trying to piece something together, not challenging.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、もしやこの目撃情報、関連かと検討中です
lines.en: We're currently examining whether this eyewitness account might be connected to the case.
lines.style: Measured official tone. Each phrase deliberate. Not rushed—this is procedural language, slightly formal. The slight pause before 'connected' suggests careful consideration of whether to make this connection public.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、被害者のヒロシさんの証言を警察、取られたんですね
lines.en: So the victim—Hiroshi—his testimony has already been taken by police?
lines.style: Quiet realization dawning. Gentle inflection upward at the end of the statement. Processing information he's just been given. Respectful, careful with the victim's name.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、ひろしという別名の容疑者を追っております
lines.en: We're currently tracking a suspect who goes by the alias 'Hiroshi.'
lines.style: Flat, important clarification. Light emphasis on the word 'alias'—this distinction matters. Deliberate pacing. The slight shift in tone suggests this detail changes the picture significantly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、警察がひろい範囲で捜査中ですね
lines.en: So the police investigation is covering quite a wide area, then.
lines.style: Soft understanding tone. Not a question despite the upward lilt—more of a confirmation to himself. Breathing quiet. The pacing is slower, suggesting the weight of what 'wide area' implies.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、押収品をいじり過ぎないよう保管しております
lines.en: We're being careful to preserve seized evidence without unnecessary handling.
lines.style: Official, protective tone. Emphasis on 'careful' and 'preserve'—these words matter. Steady, unhurried delivery. The voice of someone explaining proper procedure with quiet authority.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、現場のココ商店から証言を警察、伺ったんですね
lines.en: So you've collected testimony from Koko Store near the scene?
lines.style: Quiet confirmation, almost thinking to himself. Slight lift on the name—softening it, keeping this human-scale even within the investigation. The question trails very softly at the end, like he's fitting pieces together.
